corpus.text: The lighthouse keeper has returned.
My compass points toward the ruins.
Her gloves are covered in ash.
The elevator stopped between floors.
Our pilot forgot the landing code.
This helmet muffles every sound.
Someone moved the bronze mirror.
The market closes before sunset.
Your lantern attracts those insects.
A familiar voice called from below.
The waterwheel turns against the current.
Our tracker found fresh claw marks.
That robot recognizes your insignia.
The balcony overlooks an empty garden.
His boots leave silver footprints.
The carriage needs a new axle.
My radio receives only static.
The giant appears to be sleeping.
Her portrait conceals a narrow passage.
The desert wind carries distant music.
The baker remembered our faces even though we had visited in disguise.
He traded his last pearl for a ticket aboard the departing airship.
We discovered a handwritten invitation inside the damaged mechanical bird.
The dancer kept performing long after the audience had left the hall.
My uncle built this shelter during the first volcanic eruption.
She returned the medal because the victory had cost too many lives.
The astronomer vanished on the evening when both moons turned orange.
I recognized the tune from a lullaby my grandmother used to sing.
Their leader placed a white feather beside each empty bunk.
The diplomat seemed relieved when the meeting ended without an agreement.
We reached the monastery just as its oldest bell cracked in half.
His daughter repaired the watch but kept the mysterious engraving secret.
The rescued sailor described an island absent from every official chart.
She offered us shelter in exchange for a story about the mainland.
The historian hid the original manuscript inside an ordinary recipe book.
Our guide grew nervous whenever the conversation turned to the abandoned station.
The gardener planted roses along the road where his companions disappeared.
I expected an apology, but he handed me a freshly sharpened dagger.
Their final broadcast repeated a set of coordinates nobody could explain.
The young mechanic smiled when the ancient engine finally began to hum.
Cover the rear entrance while the miners climb the emergency ladder.
Place the empty lantern on the platform beside the marble basin.
Bring spare cables to the technician working inside the observation dome.
Follow the orange flags through the field of dormant stone giants.
Ask the ferryman to leave enough space for the medical wagon.
Hold the rope steady while I inspect the broken suspension cable.
Gather the scattered documents before the wind carries them into the canal.
Lead the frightened animals away from the malfunctioning defense turret.
Turn the central dial clockwise until the indicator reaches the green mark.
Carry the sealed container upright throughout the journey across the dunes.
Check the lower decks for passengers who missed the evacuation announcement.
Leave a wooden marker wherever the underground trail divides into two paths.
Draw the creature toward the shallow pool beside the ruined amphitheater.
Wait for the patrol boat to pass before swimming across the inlet.
Deliver the replacement lens to the lookout stationed above the canyon.
Use the maintenance hatch to reach the control room beneath the arena.
Help the apprentice arrange the colored stones around the damaged sundial.
Signal the caravan when the final obstacle has been removed.
Collect the fallen branches and reinforce the shelter before the hail arrives.
Read the inscription aloud while I examine the symbols on the ceiling.
This shield restores 18 energy after blocking 3 consecutive attacks.
If the platform begins shaking, release the handle and crouch immediately.
Only enter the chamber when both pressure gauges display exactly 60.
The drone scans a radius of 14 meters for 8 seconds.
Deliver 5 medical kits before the countdown reaches 01:30.
Do not cross the painted line while the examination lamp is flashing.
Your critical chance increases by 12% while your health remains above 75%.
The special ammunition pierces 2 targets but deals 30% less damage afterward.
You cannot equip this relic until your reputation reaches level 9.
After collecting 11 fragments, return to the excavation supervisor.
If the scanner detects movement, remain still for at least 4 seconds.
The protective field lasts 16 seconds unless its generator is destroyed.
Do not spend the last repair charge before checking the rear engine.
Each rescued worker adds 25 seconds to the remaining evacuation time.
This recipe requires 3 mushrooms, 2 bottles of water, and 1 copper pot.
You may choose another reward only after declining the offered weapon.
The eastern lift remains unavailable until the power conduit is repaired.
Prevent the crawler from losing more than 35% of its armor.
The marked opponent takes 22 additional damage from your next ranged attack.
Do not interrupt the ritual unless the outer circle changes from gold to violet.
The curator insists that the damaged painting depicts a real location, although the coastline in the background resembles nothing on our modern maps.
We could follow the smugglers through the caves, but the rising tide would trap anyone who failed to reach the second exit before nightfall.
She accepted the assignment because it offered a chance to find her missing teacher, rather than because she believed the promised reward would ever be paid.
The caretaker asked us to repair the broken fountain before searching the mansion, explaining that its running water kept the restless spirits calm.
Although the new armor protected him from the explosion, its weight prevented him from escaping the flooded compartment without help from the other divers.
I left the package beside the red doorway as instructed, yet the woman who collected it claimed she had expected us to arrive several days earlier.
If you decide to reopen the laboratory, make sure the ventilation system is working before disturbing any of the dust covering the experimental equipment.
The envoy brought a proposal that seemed generous at first, but accepting its final condition would leave the border villages entirely dependent on foreign supplies.
Our scout believes the tracks belong to a wounded animal, though their perfectly even spacing suggests that someone may be trying to lure us into an ambush.
Before activating the beacon, gather everyone inside the reinforced shelter and check that the emergency shutters can still close over the damaged western windows.
The singer recognized the stolen instrument by a tiny scratch near its handle, a detail she had described to the investigators before they found the suspect.
You are free to take the mountain route, provided that you bring enough climbing equipment for the companions who have never crossed an ice field before.
The captain refused to abandon the cargo until we showed him that the cracked containers were leaking a substance capable of dissolving the ships wooden hull.
We assumed the apprentice had misunderstood the instructions, until the master admitted that he had deliberately given her an incomplete version of the spell.
If the creatures remain quiet after the music stops, lower your weapons slowly and allow the youngest one to approach the food placed near the entrance.
The abandoned tram still runs between the two settlements, but nobody knows who repairs its engine or why it always stops at the empty hillside station.
She would have recognized the impostor sooner if the council had allowed her to examine the signature on the treaty instead of keeping it locked away.
The device can locate buried metal objects, but it cannot distinguish valuable artifacts from ordinary scrap without a separate reading from the portable analyzer.
After the storm passes, send a messenger to each neighboring village so that we can learn which roads are safe enough for the supply convoys to use.
We have enough medicine to stabilize the injured passengers tonight, but finding a doctor before morning will require someone to cross the damaged railway bridge.

translations.target: 緊握繩索，我檢查斷裂的懸吊繩。

translations.source: Gather the scattered documents before the wind carries them into the canal
translations.target: 收集散落的檔案，以免風將其吹入水道

translations.source: Gather the scattered documents before the wind carries them into the canal.
translations.target: 收集散落的檔案，以免風將其吹入水道。

translations.source: Lead the frightened animals away from the malfunctioning defense turret.
translations.target: 帶領驚慌的動物遠離故障的防禦 turret。

translations.source: Turn the central dial clockwise until the indicator reaches the green mark.
translations.target: 轉動中央旋鈕順時針方向，直到指標達到綠色標記。

translations.source: Carry the sealed container upright throughout the journey across the dunes.
translations.target: 將封印容器直立運輸於沙丘之間的旅程中。

translations.source:
Check the lower decks for passengers who missed the evacuation
announcement.
translations.target: 檢查下層船艙是否有乘客未聽見疏散公告。

translations.source: Leave a wooden marker wherever the underground trail divides into two paths.
translations.target: 離開每個地下迷宮分岔處，放置一個木製標記。

translations.source: Draw the creature toward the shallow pool beside the ruined amphitheater.
translations.target: 將生物朝著廢墟旁邊的淺水池方向引導。

translations.source: Wait for the patrol boat to pass before swimming across the inlet.
translations.target: 等待巡邏船透過後再游泳穿越入口。

translations.source: Deliver the replacement lens to the lookout stationed above the canyon.
translations.target: 將替換鏡片遞給位於峽谷上方的瞭望員。

translations.source: Use the maintenance hatch to reach the control room beneath the arena.
translations.target: 使用維修門前往競技場下方的控制室。

translations.source: Help the apprentice arrange the colored stones around the damaged sundial.
translations.target: 協助學徒將彩色石子擺放在損壞的太陽晷周圍。

translations.source: Signal the caravan when the final obstacle has been removed.
translations.target: 傳送門啟動時，最後的障礙已清除。

translations.source: Collect the fallen branches and reinforce the shelter before the hail arrives.
translations.target: 收集掉落的枝葉並加強庇護所，直到雷暴到來。

translations.source: Read the inscription aloud while I examine the symbols on the ceiling.
translations.target: 我檢查天花板上的符文時，同時將銘文讀出聲來。

translations.source: This shield restores 18 energy after blocking 3 consecutive attacks.
translations.target: 此護盾在擋住3連連攻擊後會恢復18點能量。

translations.source: If the platform begins shaking, release the handle and crouch immediately.
translations.target: 如果平臺開始搖晃，請釋放手柄並立即蹲下。

translations.source: Only enter the chamber when both pressure gauges display exactly 60.
translations.target: 僅在兩壓力計顯示正好60時才可進入密室。

translations.source: The drone scans a radius of 14 meters for 8 seconds.
translations.target: 無人機在8秒內掃描半徑為14米的範圍。

translations.source: Deliver 5 medical kits before the countdown reaches 01:30.
translations.target: 傳送門 5 醫療包 在計時器達到 01:30 前交付。

translations.source: Do not cross the painted line while the examination lamp is flashing.
translations.target: 不要在考試燈閃爍時穿越畫有線的區域。

translations.source: Your critical chance increases by 12% while your health remains above 75%.
translations.target: 你的攻擊成功率增加 12%，而你的血量仍高於 75%。

translations.source:
The special ammunition pierces 2 targets but deals 30% less damage
afterward.
translations.target: 特殊彈藥穿透2個目標，但之後造成30%的傷害較少。

translations.source: You cannot equip this relic until your reputation reaches level 9.
translations.target: 你不能在聲譽達到級別 9 之前裝備這件聖物。

translations.source: After collecting 11 fragments, return to the excavation supervisor.
translations.target: 收集到11塊碎片後，返回挖掘主管處。

translations.source: If the scanner detects movement, remain still for at least 4 seconds.
translations.target: 若掃描器偵測到移動，則需保持靜止至少4秒。

translations.source: The protective field lasts 16 seconds unless its generator is destroyed.
translations.target: 保護場持續16秒，除非其發電機被摧毀。

translations.source: Do not spend the last repair charge before checking the rear engine.
translations.target: 不要在檢查後引擎之前消耗最後的修復費用。

translations.source: Each rescued worker adds 25 seconds to the remaining evacuation time.
translations.target: 每個救出的工人會增加25秒的剩餘疏散時間。

translations.source: This recipe requires 3 mushrooms, 2 bottles of water, and 1 copper pot.
translations.target: 此配方需要3種蘑菇、2瓶水和1個銅鍋。

translations.source: You may choose another reward only after declining the offered weapon.
translations.target: 你可以選擇另一個獎勵，只有在拒絕所提供的武器之後。

translations.source: The eastern lift remains unavailable until the power conduit is repaired.
translations.target: 東方傳送門暫時無法使用，直到電力導管修復完成。

translations.source: Prevent the crawler from losing more than 35% of its armor.
translations.target: 防止爬蟲損失超過 35% 的防禦裝備。

translations.source:
The marked opponent takes 22 additional damage from your next ranged
attack.
translations.target: 標註的對手從你的下一次遠距離攻擊中獲得22點額外傷害。

translations.source: Do not interrupt the ritual unless the outer circle changes from gold to violet.
translations.target: 不論外圓是否從黃金轉為紫羅蘭，都不應中斷儀式。

translations.source:
The curator insists that the damaged painting depicts a real location, although
the coastline in the background resembles nothing on our modern maps.
translations.target: 導覽員堅持認為這幅損壞的畫作描繪的是真實的地理位置，儘管背景的海岸線與我們現代的海圖上所顯示的毫無相似之處。

translations.source:
We could follow the smugglers through the caves, but the rising tide would trap
anyone who failed to reach the second exit before nightfall.
translations.target: 我們可以透過洞穴跟隨走私者，但潮水上升會將任何未能在夜幕降臨前達到第二個出口的人困住。

translations.source:
She accepted the assignment because it offered a chance to find her missing
teacher, rather than because she believed the promised reward would ever be
paid.
translations.target: 她接受任務，因為這項任務提供了尋找她失蹤老師的機會，而不是因為她相信承諾的獎勵會永遠支付。

translations.source:
The caretaker asked us to repair the broken fountain before searching the
mansion, explaining that its running water kept the restless spirits calm.
translations.target: 守護者要求我們在搜尋 mansion 之前修復破損的噴泉，並說明其持續的水流能讓不安的靈魂保持平靜。

translations.source:
Although the new armor protected him from the explosion, its weight prevented
him from escaping the flooded compartment without help from the other divers.
translations.target: 雖然新裝甲保護了他免受爆炸的傷害，但它的重量卻使他無法在沒有其他潛水員幫助的情況下從 flooded compartment 中逃出。

translations.source:
I left the package beside the red doorway as instructed, yet the woman who
collected it claimed she had expected us to arrive several days earlier.
translations.target: 我按照指示將包裹放在紅門旁邊，但收集包裹的婦人卻說她本應預期我們幾天前就到來。

translations.source:
If you decide to reopen the laboratory, make sure the ventilation system is
working before disturbing any of the dust covering the experimental equipment.
translations.target: 如果你決定重新開啟實驗室，請在擾動任何覆蓋在實驗裝置上的塵埃之前，確保空氣迴圈系統正常運轉。

translations.source:
The envoy brought a proposal that seemed generous at first, but accepting its
final condition would leave the border villages entirely dependent on foreign
supplies.
translations.target: 使節帶來一個看似慷慨的建議，但接受其最終條件將使邊境村莊完全依賴外國供應。

translations.source:
Our scout believes the tracks belong to a wounded animal, though their
perfectly even spacing suggests that someone may be trying to lure us into an
ambush.
translations.target: 我們的探路者認為這些腳印屬於受傷的動物，儘管他們的完美均勻間距暗示有人可能在試圖引我們落入陷阱。

translations.source:
Before activating the beacon, gather everyone inside the reinforced shelter and
check that the emergency shutters can still close over the damaged western
windows.
translations.target: 在啟動聖光之鑑之前，請將所有人聚集在強化避難所內，並確認緊急滑軌仍能關閉以覆蓋損壞的西方窗戶。

translations.source:
The singer recognized the stolen instrument by a tiny scratch near its handle, a
detail she had described to the investigators before they found the suspect.
translations.target: 歌手透過處理樂器邊緣附近一小處刮痕，辨識出這把偷走的樂器，這一事項她先前已向調查人員描述過。

translations.source:
You are free to take the mountain route, provided that you bring enough
climbing equipment for the companions who have never crossed an ice field
before.
translations.warning: 譯文可能遺漏否定，已保留原文。

translations.source:
The captain refused to abandon the cargo until we showed him that the
cracked containers were leaking a substance capable of dissolving the ships
wooden hull.
translations.target: 船長拒絕在我們證明出裂損的容器正在洩漏一種能溶解船隻木質船殼的物質之前放棄貨物。

translations.source:
We assumed the apprentice had misunderstood the instructions, until the
master admitted that he had deliberately given her an incomplete version of the
spell.
translations.target: 我們假設師傅誤解了指令，直到師傅承認他故意給她一個不完整的咒語版本。

translations.source:
If the creatures remain quiet after the music stops, lower your weapons slowly
and allow the youngest one to approach the food placed near the entrance.
translations.target: 若戰士們在音樂停止後仍保持靜靜，則請緩緩降低武器，讓最年輕的一個接近入口附近放置的食物。

translations.source:
The abandoned tram still runs between the two settlements, but nobody knows
who repairs its engine or why it always stops at the empty hillside station.
translations.target: 廢棄的電車仍沿著兩座聚落之間的路線執行，但沒有人知道誰維修其引擎，也沒有人知道為什麼它總是停在空置的山坡站。

translations.source:
She would have recognized the impostor sooner if the council had allowed her
to examine the signature on the treaty instead of keeping it locked away.
translations.target: 她若能在議會允許她檢視協議上的簽名而非將其鎖起來之前就識別出偽裝者，就會更早識別出偽裝者。

translations.source:
The device can locate buried metal objects, but it cannot distinguish valuable
artifacts from ordinary scrap without a separate reading from the portable
analyzer.
translations.target: 裝置可以定位埋藏的金屬物件，但沒有獨立的移動分析器讀取，它無法區分貴重文物與普通廢料。

translations.source:
After the storm passes, send a messenger to each neighboring village so that
we can learn which roads are safe enough for the supply convoys to use.
translations.target: 暴風雨過後，向每個鄰近村落派送信使，以便我們瞭解哪條道路適合供供應車隊使用。

translations.source:
We have enough medicine to stabilize the injured passengers tonight, but
finding a doctor before morning will require someone to cross the damaged
railway bridge.
translations.target: 我們今晚有足夠的藥物來穩定受傷乘客，但要在清晨前找到醫生，需要有人穿越損壞的鐵路橋。

ui.source: The lighthouse keeper has returned.
ui.target: 燈塔守護者已返回。

ui.source: My compass points toward the ruins.
ui.target: 我的指南針指向廢墟。

ui.source: Her gloves are covered in ash.
ui.target: 她的手套覆滿灰塵。

ui.source: The elevator stopped between floors.
ui.target: 電梯停在樓層之間。

ui.source: Our pilot forgot the landing code.
ui.target: 我們的飛行員忘記了降落碼。

ui.source: This helmet muffles every sound.
ui.target: 這頭盔會掩蓋所有聲音。

ui.source: Someone moved the bronze mirror.
ui.target: 某人移動了銅鏡。

ui.source: The market closes before sunset.
ui.target: 市場在日落前關閉。

ui.source: Your lantern attracts those insects.
ui.target: 你的燈籠吸引那些蟲子。

ui.source: A familiar voice called from below.
ui.target: 一個熟悉的聲音從下方呼喊。

ui.source: The waterwheel turns against the current.
ui.target: 水輪逆流而轉。

ui.source: Our tracker found fresh claw marks.
ui.target: 我們的追蹤者發現了新的爪痕。

ui.source: That robot recognizes your insignia.
ui.target: 那臺機器識別你的徽章。

ui.source: The balcony overlooks an empty garden.
ui.target: 陽臺俯瞰著一個空曠的花園。

ui.source: His boots leave silver footprints.
ui.target: 他的靴子留下銀色的腳印。

ui.source: The carriage needs a new axle.
ui.target: 車輛需要新的軸.

ui.source: My radio receives only static.
ui.target: 我的收音機只接收靜電。

ui.source: The giant appears to be sleeping.
ui.target: 巨人的形狀看起來像是在沉睡。

ui.source: Her portrait conceals a narrow passage.
ui.target: 她的肖像隱藏著一條窄小的通道。

ui.source: The desert wind carries distant music.
ui.target: 沙漠風傳來遠處的音樂。

ui.source: The baker remembered our faces even though we had visited in disguise.
ui.target: 糕餅師記起我們的臉即使我們以假面形式來訪。

ui.source: He traded his last pearl for a ticket aboard the departing airship.
ui.target: 他以最後的珍珠換得一張搭乘離港飛船的票。

ui.source: We discovered a handwritten invitation inside the damaged mechanical bird.
ui.target: 我們發現了損壞機械鴿內寫有手寫邀請函。

ui.source: The dancer kept performing long after the audience had left the hall.
ui.target: 舞者在場館人潮散去後仍持續表演。

ui.source: The dancer kept performing long after the audience had left the hall
ui.target: 舞者在場館人離後仍持續表演

ui.source: My uncle built this shelter during the first volcanic eruption.
ui.target: 我叔叔在第一次火山爆發時建造了這個避難所。

ui.source: She returned the medal because the victory had cost too many lives.
ui.target: 她將獎牌歸還，因為勝利的獲勝導致太多人喪生。

ui.source: The astronomer vanished on the evening when both moons turned orange.
ui.target: 天文學家在雙月變為橙色的傍晚消失。

ui.source: I recognized the tune from a lullaby my grandmother used to sing.
ui.target: 我從祖母常唱的搖籃曲中辨識出這首歌。

ui.source: Their leader placed a white feather beside each empty bunk.
ui.target: 他們的領導者將一隻白羽放在每個空床位旁邊。

ui.source: The diplomat seemed relieved when the meeting ended without an agreement.
ui.target: 外交官在會議結束時沒有達成協議時顯得鬆了鬆緊。

ui.source: We reached the monastery just as its oldest bell cracked in half.
ui.target: 我們剛好在那座寺廟到來時，最老的鐘聲裂成兩半。

ui.source: His daughter repaired the watch but kept the mysterious engraving secret.
ui.target: 他女兒修復了時計，但保留了神秘的鑽刻符文秘密。

ui.source: The rescued sailor described an island absent from every official chart.
ui.target: 被救的水手描述了一個不在任何官方海圖中的島嶼。

ui.source: She offered us shelter in exchange for a story about the mainland.
ui.target: 她以提供庇護為條件，換取有關主島的故事。

ui.source: She offered us shelter in exchange for a story about the mainland
ui.target: 她以提供庇護為條件，換取有關大陸的故事

ui.source: The historian hid the original manuscript inside an ordinary recipe book.
ui.target: 歷史學家將原始手稿藏於一本普通的食譜書中。

ui.source: Our guide grew nervous whenever the conversation turned to the abandoned station.
ui.target: 我們的導覽員在談話轉向廢棄站點時總是顯得擔憂。

ui.source: The gardener planted roses along the road where his companions disappeared.
ui.target: 園丁在與同伴失散的路邊種植了玫瑰。

ui.source: I expected an apology, but he handed me a freshly sharpened dagger.
ui.target: 我預期會收到道歉，但他卻遞給我一把剛剛 sharpened 的匕首。

ui.source: Their final broadcast repeated a set of coordinates nobody could explain.
ui.target: 他們的最後廣播重複了一組無法解釋的座標。

ui.source: The young mechanic smiled when the ancient engine finally began to hum.
ui.target: 年輕的機械師在古舊引擎終於開始發聲時笑了。

ui.source: Cover the rear entrance while the miners climb the emergency ladder.
ui.target: 掩護後門，當礦工爬行緊急梯時。

ui.source: Place the empty lantern on the platform beside the marble basin.
ui.target: 將空 lantern 放置在平臺上，靠近 marble basin 的位置。

ui.source: Bring spare cables to the technician working inside the observation dome.
ui.target: 將備用電線帶到正在於觀測球幕內工作的技術員旁邊。

ui.source: Follow the orange flags through the field of dormant stone giants.
ui.target: 跟著橙色旗子穿越沉睡的巨石巨人之場。

ui.source: Ask the ferryman to leave enough space for the medical wagon.
ui.target: 請讓渡船伕為醫療車留出足夠空間。

ui.source: Hold the rope steady while I inspect the broken suspension cable.
ui.target: 緊握繩索，我檢查斷裂的懸吊繩。

ui.source: Gather the scattered documents before the wind carries them into the canal
ui.target: 收集散落的檔案，以免風將其吹入水道

ui.target: 你不能在聲譽達到級別 9 之前裝備這件聖物。

ui.source: After collecting 11 fragments, return to the excavation supervisor.
ui.target: 收集到11塊碎片後，返回挖掘主管處。

ui.source: If the scanner detects movement, remain still for at least 4 seconds.
ui.target: 若掃描器偵測到移動，則需保持靜止至少4秒。

ui.source: The protective field lasts 16 seconds unless its generator is destroyed.
ui.target: 保護場持續16秒，除非其發電機被摧毀。

ui.source: Do not spend the last repair charge before checking the rear engine.
ui.target: 不要在檢查後引擎之前消耗最後的修復費用。

ui.source: Each rescued worker adds 25 seconds to the remaining evacuation time.
ui.target: 每個救出的工人會增加25秒的剩餘疏散時間。

ui.source: This recipe requires 3 mushrooms, 2 bottles of water, and 1 copper pot.
ui.target: 此配方需要3種蘑菇、2瓶水和1個銅鍋。

ui.source: You may choose another reward only after declining the offered weapon.
ui.target: 你可以選擇另一個獎勵，只有在拒絕所提供的武器之後。

ui.source: The eastern lift remains unavailable until the power conduit is repaired.
ui.target: 東方傳送門暫時無法使用，直到電力導管修復完成。

ui.source: Prevent the crawler from losing more than 35% of its armor.
ui.target: 防止爬蟲損失超過 35% 的防禦裝備。

ui.source: The marked opponent takes 22 additional damage from your next ranged attack.
ui.target: 標註的對手從你的下一次遠距離攻擊中獲得22點額外傷害。

ui.source: Do not interrupt the ritual unless the outer circle changes from gold to violet.
ui.target: 不論外圓是否從黃金轉為紫羅蘭，都不應中斷儀式。

ui.source: The curator insists that the damaged painting depicts a real location, although the coastline in the background resembles nothing on our modern maps.
ui.target: 導覽員堅持認為這幅損壞的畫作描繪的是真實的地理位置，儘管背景的海岸線與我們現代的海圖上所顯示的毫無相似之處。

ui.source: We could follow the smugglers through the caves, but the rising tide would trap anyone who failed to reach the second exit before nightfall.
ui.target: 我們可以透過洞穴跟隨走私者，但潮水上升會將任何未能在夜幕降臨前達到第二個出口的人困住。

ui.source: She accepted the assignment because it offered a chance to find her missing teacher, rather than because she believed the promised reward would ever be paid.
ui.target: 她接受任務，因為這項任務提供了尋找她失蹤老師的機會，而不是因為她相信承諾的獎勵會永遠支付。

ui.source: The caretaker asked us to repair the broken fountain before searching the mansion, explaining that its running water kept the restless spirits calm.
ui.target: 守護者要求我們在搜尋 mansion 之前修復破損的噴泉，並說明其持續的水流能讓不安的靈魂保持平靜。

ui.source: Although the new armor protected him from the explosion, its weight prevented him from escaping the flooded compartment without help from the other divers.
ui.target: 雖然新裝甲保護了他免受爆炸的傷害，但它的重量卻使他無法在沒有其他潛水員幫助的情況下從 flooded compartment 中逃出。

ui.source: I left the package beside the red doorway as instructed, yet the woman who collected it claimed she had expected us to arrive several days earlier.
ui.target: 我按照指示將包裹放在紅門旁邊，但收集包裹的婦人卻說她本應預期我們幾天前就到來。

ui.source: If you decide to reopen the laboratory, make sure the ventilation system is working before disturbing any of the dust covering the experimental equipment.
ui.target: 如果你決定重新開啟實驗室，請在擾動任何覆蓋在實驗裝置上的塵埃之前，確保空氣迴圈系統正常運轉。

ui.source: The envoy brought a proposal that seemed generous at first, but accepting its final condition would leave the border villages entirely dependent on foreign supplies.
ui.target: 使節帶來一個看似慷慨的建議，但接受其最終條件將使邊境村莊完全依賴外國供應。

ui.source: Our scout believes the tracks belong to a wounded animal, though their perfectly even spacing suggests that someone may be trying to lure us into an ambush.
ui.target: 我們的探路者認為這些腳印屬於受傷的動物，儘管他們的完美均勻間距暗示有人可能在試圖引我們落入陷阱。

ui.source: Before activating the beacon, gather everyone inside the reinforced shelter and check that the emergency shutters can still close over the damaged western windows.
ui.target: 在啟動聖光之鑑之前，請將所有人聚集在強化避難所內，並確認緊急滑軌仍能關閉以覆蓋損壞的西方窗戶。

ui.source: The singer recognized the stolen instrument by a tiny scratch near its handle, a detail she had described to the investigators before they found the suspect.
ui.target: 歌手透過處理樂器邊緣附近一小處刮痕，辨識出這把偷走的樂器，這一事項她先前已向調查人員描述過。

ui.source: You are free to take the mountain route, provided that you bring enough climbing equipment for the companions who have never crossed an ice field before.
ui.warning: 需核對 · 譯文可能遺漏否定，已保留原文。

ui.source: The captain refused to abandon the cargo until we showed him that the cracked containers were leaking a substance capable of dissolving the ships wooden hull.
ui.target: 船長拒絕在我們證明出裂損的容器正在洩漏一種能溶解船隻木質船殼的物質之前放棄貨物。

ui.source: We assumed the apprentice had misunderstood the instructions, until the master admitted that he had deliberately given her an incomplete version of the spell.
ui.target: 我們假設師傅誤解了指令，直到師傅承認他故意給她一個不完整的咒語版本。

ui.source: If the creatures remain quiet after the music stops, lower your weapons slowly and allow the youngest one to approach the food placed near the entrance.
ui.target: 若戰士們在音樂停止後仍保持靜靜，則請緩緩降低武器，讓最年輕的一個接近入口附近放置的食物。

ui.source: The abandoned tram still runs between the two settlements, but nobody knows who repairs its engine or why it always stops at the empty hillside station.
ui.target: 廢棄的電車仍沿著兩座聚落之間的路線執行，但沒有人知道誰維修其引擎，也沒有人知道為什麼它總是停在空置的山坡站。

ui.source: She would have recognized the impostor sooner if the council had allowed her to examine the signature on the treaty instead of keeping it locked away.
ui.target: 她若能在議會允許她檢視協議上的簽名而非將其鎖起來之前就識別出偽裝者，就會更早識別出偽裝者。

ui.source: The device can locate buried metal objects, but it cannot distinguish valuable artifacts from ordinary scrap without a separate reading from the portable analyzer.
ui.target: 裝置可以定位埋藏的金屬物件，但沒有獨立的移動分析器讀取，它無法區分貴重文物與普通廢料。

ui.source: After the storm passes, send a messenger to each neighboring village so that we can learn which roads are safe enough for the supply convoys to use.
ui.target: 暴風雨過後，向每個鄰近村落派送信使，以便我們瞭解哪條道路適合供供應車隊使用。

ui.source: We have enough medicine to stabilize the injured passengers tonight, but finding a doctor before morning will require someone to cross the damaged railway bridge.
ui.target: 我們今晚有足夠的藥物來穩定受傷乘客，但要在清晨前找到醫生，需要有人穿越損壞的鐵路橋。

scope: Static and moving versions of the same synthetic noisy scene, each 100 sentences x 3 s. Production monitor and real CPU OCR/CUDA/Qt. Measured fixture appearance to UI, including default polling and stability. No GDI capture/compositor/game FPS claim; app CPU includes fixture rendering.
